query:
INSERT INTO customerPayments (customerId, paidDate, paidAmount, paymentMethod, notes)
SELECT 
  rp.customerId,
  rp.paidDate,
  rp.paidAmount,
  rp.paymentMethod,
  'Migrado de receivablePayments'
FROM receivablePayments rp
JOIN partners p ON rp.customerId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Vitor Hugo%' 
  AND rp.id IN (180001, 180002, 180003, 180004);
